hooks.name: Schema change checklist
hooks.description: A schema edit needs a migration, an env/docs check and a matching data-model section.

action.prompt: src/server/db/schema.ts changed. Check that: (1) a migration was generated with `pnpm db:generate` and no applied migration in drizzle/ was edited; (2) every new table has a userId column with a cascade FK to the Better Auth user and every query on it filters by ctx.session.user.id; (3) the data-model section of plan/fin-bro/architecture.md and the README paragraph 'Data model in one paragraph' still match; (4) scripts/delete-user.ts still removes everything the user owns. Report what you fixed or what still needs the owner.
